evidence.name: Screen field: Space around the field
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space around the field" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space around the field
sections.description: Sets the gap OUTSIDE the field, separating it from the title above and anything below, on the top, right, bottom, and left. Use it to give the field room to breathe within the screen. This is the space around the field — distinct from Internal Padding, which is the space inside it.
